environment.display_scheduling: host display GPU; WDDM on Windows

protocol.event_interval: one launch between default-stream events; includes scheduling and enqueue gaps
protocol.excluded: context/module setup, host fixture allocation, reference validation, log/statistic generation
protocol.order: packed-first on even pairs; lane-first on odd pairs
protocol.timed_domain: only certificate-admitted boxes; deterministic fixture cycling
protocol.transfer_call: input copy, output poisoning, launch/event management, wait and complete guarded output copy
